provenance.notes: Existing SwarmEnv.rule_actions(): target user i modulo user count; fixed gains 0.06 and 0.6, no collision avoidance. Uses agent-index assignment. Same evaluator and seeds as maintained-model validation; replay contains only the first evaluation scenario.

config.implementation: maintained-reference-v0.2; not an exact historical reproduction

summary.uncertainty_unit: scenario variation of one fixed non-learning policy; NOT training seeds

metric_definitions.communication: sum-link spectral efficiency, bit/s/Hz; no bandwidth/association model
metric_definitions.sensing_proxy: dimensionless SNR proxy; not CRB or positioning RMSE
metric_definitions.speed_cost: weighted sum of UAV speeds; not energy in joules
metric_definitions.collision_episode: at least one sampled distance below safe_distance, including the reset state; not continuous-time safety
metric_definitions.attention: weights computed from the observation at this same replay frame
